messages:
alex: heads-up — vendor just asked if we want them to pre-seed a GPU pool for next week's bench soak. asking what region/sku to lock and whether we should request a soft hold vs lease.

maria: can you share the soak window + expected qps? i'll check procurement + cost impact.

alex: soak is mon→wed, 6am-6pm PT daily. target mix: 6 x h100, 12 x a100 (40/60 token mix). qps ~1200 peak for generation load.

maria: ok. prelim: vendor can soft-hold for 48h, lease needs PO and notice. soft-hold is free but not guaranteed; lease is charged. i'll open a ticket to vendor ops.

jinwoo: we should also confirm our cloud quotas in us-west1 and asia-east1 before we tell them to pre-seed. last time we assumed cross-region fallback would be automatic and it wasn't. quick check: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format=json quotas`

sarah: +1 on quota check. i can run a sweep this afternoon and post results. also suggest adding a tiny terraform var so we can flip the canary to spot fallback if lease fails.

ops-bot: deploy-ticket #INF-4921 created by maria: "Vendor soft-hold request + quota check for bench soak" — assignees: eng-infra, procurement.

maria: jinwoo — can you paste the small TF snippet you mentioned? saves me a manual step when toggling fallback.

jinwoo: sure — snippet below (will push as a tiny PR):
```
variable "use_spot_fallback" {
  type    = bool
  default = false
}
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "bench" {
  region      = var.region
  sku_mix     = var.sku_mix
  fallback_spot = var.use_spot_fallback
}
```

alex: perfect. maria — if vendor can only do 48h soft-hold i'd say lock h100 as lease (we need deterministic latency for the soak) and soft-hold the rest. procurement okay with mixed approach?

maria: i'll propose that plan in the ticket. need approval from finance for the single h100 lease; pinging finance in the ticket.

ops-bot: reminder — please attach anticipated token/hour estimate to the ticket for billing projection.

alex: adding numbers to the ticket now (est. 30M tokens/day during soak). thanks all — will wait for procurement confirmation before replying to vendor. :thumbsup:
